table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Type = (SELECT VocherCategory.Name FROM VocherCategory WHERE VocherCategory.VochCatCode = H.VochCatCode),
	GLCODE = H.GLVochCode,
	H.VoucherCode,
	Date = H.Date, 
	AccCode=D.AccCode,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Title = A.Name,
	Amount = D.Debit - D.Credit,
	Remarks = D.Remarks,
	HRemarks=H.Remarks,
	ChequeNo= D.ChkNo,
	Posted=H.Posted,
	D.Balance,
	InvoiceCode=D.InvoiceCode,
	InvoiceBased=(SELECT VocherCategory.InvoiceBased FROM VocherCategory WHERE VocherCategory.VochCatCode = H.VochCatCode),
	UserName = (SELECT U.username FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = H.SalesManCode),
	PrintBalance = :ai_printbalance
FROM
	GLHeader H,
	GLDetail D,
	Accounts A
WHERE
	H.GLVochCode = :ai_glvochcode AND
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND
	H.AccCode <> D.AccCode AND
	D.AccCode = A.AccCode
ORDER BY
	H.GLVochCode,
	D.GLRowID
